_comment: P3-3 Spring AI bodies EN（2026-11-03）。sections 与源侧固定小节对齐；sources 按索引对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: A portable Model API behind one interface across providers; official docs list ChatClient and the model APIs. The current supported list follows official docs and is not enumerated here.
axes.runtime: Runs inside a Spring Boot application: official starters and auto-configuration inject models and vector stores as Spring beans.
axes.local_files: Document ingestion (ETL) and vector stores are configured by the application; the framework hosts no data itself.
axes.background: A library with no built-in task queue; async and long-running work is orchestrated on the Spring side.
axes.tools: Supports tool calling and MCP: official docs state it can consume MCP servers and expose Spring services to the AI ecosystem.
axes.context: Conversation memory is managed through ChatClient and memory configuration; persistence is yours to attach.
axes.permissions: Runs within Spring Security; permissions are application-configured, with no built-in multi-tenant isolation.
axes.fit: Fits Spring Boot teams who want AI as standard Spring components and need MCP plus vector-store integration. Does not fit non-Java teams, turnkey agents, or lightweight scripting.

runs: This site has not completed integration or performance tests; the conclusions cover the API and capabilities disclosed in official docs only.
unknowns:
- Full current list of supported models and vector stores (not enumerated here)
- Versions and limits of bidirectional MCP integration
- Spring Boot compatibility matrix
related: Another Java route with a more LangChain-like abstraction.
